phase: Phase D - Independent Extension: Trust Policy Hardening
description: Hardened AssumeRolePolicyDocument applied to remediate the unrestricted trust relationship identified in Phase C.
hardening_controls_applied: Narrowed Principal from account root to the single explicit IAM ARN that legitimately needs the role, closing the account-wide trust that enabled hop 1.
Added sts:ExternalId condition to prevent confused-deputy / unauthorised chained assumption.
Added aws:SourceIp restriction limiting assumption to the approved lab network range.
Added aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent condition requiring MFA on the calling principal's session.
Capped sts:DurationSeconds at 3600 seconds to reduce the exposure window of any issued temporary credentials.
